prompt.project_info: Create a high-saturation retro-modern disco portrait of one original approved adult woman against a pink wall with a metallic disco ball.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with sleek brunette high ponytail, rose-tinted aviator sunglasses, pink high-leg spandex bodysuit with white piping, and glossy red high heels. She sits in a poised fashion pose on a reversed glossy red chair.
composition_elements: Vertical medium-full shot with centered silhouette.
Subject seated on the reversed chair with torso turned toward camera and legs naturally arranged.
Large multifaceted metallic silver disco ball held beside the body.
Solid hot-pink wall, sharp shadow, and small square caustic reflections from the disco ball.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Hard studio light from the left, sharp defined shadows, specular highlights on bodysuit and disco ball, clean glossy digital finish.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic vertical medium-full fashion photography, high saturation, realistic spandex and metal reflections, crisp focus, no text or watermark.
